patch.value: Restore changelog gates with the SDK full-list projection

pm-changelog 2026.10.15 invokes pm list --all --json with unbounded output but without a full projection. SDK 2026.10.19 defaults to brief and emits omission_receipt.has_omissions=true, so changelog:full/check refuse generation even when every row is returned. Forwarding --output-include full makes the list complete but is also forwarded to schema list, which the CLI rejects. Repair the producer integration without disabling completeness checks or rewriting tracker histories; then adopt its reviewed release in the consumer.

The existing complete-read guard remains enabled; changelog:full and changelog:check pass on SDK 2026.10.19 with custom item types and full item metadata; regression tests cover brief-list omission and schema discovery.
